title: Config: add [ipns] section to transit config
description: Add optional [[ipns]] TOML section to TransitConfig. Fields: enabled: bool (default false), republish_interval_secs: u64 (default 3600). Add IpnsConfig struct in config.rs with serde defaults. Add to Config struct as pub ipns: IpnsConfig. No validation needed beyond defaults. Why: lets operators opt in without changing existing deployments.
